label: Released work
meaning: A released artifact with a verifiable version and availability.

label: Working local applications
meaning: Works in the owner's local environment; public availability is separate.

label: Device-tested pilots
meaning: Tested on a named physical device within a stated scope.

label: Active prototypes
meaning: In development; tests and limitations remain explicit.

label: Private implementations
meaning: Implementation stays private; only approved public summaries may be shown.

label: Architecture/research
meaning: Concepts and research; implementation and results are not implied.

label: Historical experiments
meaning: An earlier experiment, retained with its date and limits.

label: Workshop pilots
meaning: A workshop concept or pilot; reservations, price and outcomes remain separate.
